# run
# env TOKEN=secret
# expect Authorization: Bearer secret
# note what is sent carries the value; what is stored keeps the variable
>>> f.rr
-- keeps variables on disk --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}

>>> want f.rr
-- keeps variables on disk --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 2
Content-Type: text/plain

ok
